periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Pediatric offices began giving out dental referral cards, and we drafted messages linking oral health to heart disease, diabetes and pregnancy. Partners: Harborview Community Health Center, Bayview Medical Center.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Add dental messages to prenatal classes and script a public service announcement.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Added dental messages to prenatal classes and scripted a public service announcement. More pediatric offices joined the referral card effort. Partners: Harborview Community Health Center, Bayview Medical Center, Harborview Unified School District.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Add dental messages to Family Home Visiting, air the announcement, and build the referral card into the 12-month well-child visit.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Added dental messages to prenatal classes and Family Home Visiting, and aired a short public service announcement. Pediatricians now give a dental referral card at the 12-month visit. Partners: Harborview Community Health Center, Bayview Medical Center, Harborview Unified School District.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Present oral health lessons at school health fairs and share simple messages with diabetes education classes.
